title: the Upper Fly River Rising
author: Ada Thackeray
blurb: Theo Brightwater, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
